_note: Every photo here is openly licensed and attributed. 'reviewed': false means the image has been fetched but NOT yet looked at - an unseen photo is not accepted into the accuracy set.

photos.description: Dal Makhani is a popular vegetarian dish found in West Bengal, India and all other cities of India, made up of pulses with butter and other ingredients.

photos.title: File:Urad daal with assorted indian bread and salad.jpg
photos.author: Hritik Sharma2801
photos.description: This is an image of one of the most common dish amongst Indian cuisine. This mouth watering dish consists of Urad daal served in a bowl with lots and lots of butter and an assorted indian bread commonly known as "fulka" and salad of onion and cucumber. This dish is served in almost all houses in the beautiful country of India.
photos.review_note: A yellow bowl of urad dal with two chapati on a plate, with raw onion rings, cucumber and lemon on the side. BATCH-1 CORRECTION: the first run scored onion and cucumber as INVENTED dishes. They are plainly in the photo - I described them in the note and then forgot to put them in the truth. The harness was right; my label was wrong.

photos.title: File:A North-Indian Dinner.jpg
photos.author: Tgatwork
photos.description: This picture consists of a homemade North-Indian Styled Dinner consisting of Rajmha or Kidney-Beans (in the bowl), Soya chunks and wheat Chapattis with some medicated warm water
photos.review_note: Steel plate, overhead. A bowl of chole (chickpeas in gravy with green chilli), a dry spiced potato bhaji, two chapati, and a glass of tea. BATCH-1 CORRECTION: the first label said 'Chole, Dal, Roti' - there is NO dal in this photo, and the reference total was 200 kcal short, which is what produced the alarming 37.7% error. The model was closer to right than my label was. Corrected after looking at the image at full size.

photos.title: File:Lauki Kofta Curry.JPG
photos.author: Nithajay
photos.description: Lauki Kofta curry is very popular curry recipe from Hyderabad. Koftas are deep fried balls of any ingredient which are then cooked in a thick onion-tomato gravy. In this dish, the koftas are made of lauki or bottle gourd. Lauki or bottle gourd is also known as ghiya or doodhi or dudhi or Opo squash. In this summer season, it is available in all Indian veggie market. It has more water content, so it is helpful to deal with the heat, and it prevents exhaustion in hot Indian summer.
